lines.text: # Character root is a voter, not the initiator. The saved proposal scope and serial
# must match before touching the initiating actor's counters.
# Preview does not set vote_yes; real execution has just stored it.
if = { limit = { var:lyd_c2_vote_yes = 1 } scope:lyd_c2_actor = { change_variable = { name = lyd_c2_source_yes add = 1 } } }
# Same post-write presence gate for receiving-school ballots.
limit = { exists = var:lyd_c2_source_head NOT = { var:lyd_c2_source_head = this } }
# Event-only wrapper: validate the original popup before the current helper can
# sign or send follow-up events. Never refresh/rebind the saved nonce here.
# Compare actual sets as well as counts: replacement electors, new players or a
# doctrine/status change invalidate the round even when totals remain identical.
if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { exists = head_of_rite } NOT = { head_of_rite = var:lyd_c2_snapshot_holder } } }
else_if = { limit = { exists = head_of_rite } scope:lyd_c2_actor = { set_variable = { name = lyd_c2_snapshot_valid value = 0 } } }
every_rite_tenet = { status = core scope:lyd_c2_target_school = { change_variable = { name = lyd_c2_check_count add = 1 } } }
if = { limit = { var:lyd_c2_check_count != var:lyd_c2_target_core_total } scope:lyd_c2_actor = { set_variable = { name = lyd_c2_snapshot_valid value = 0 } } }
if = { limit = { scope:lyd_c2_target_school = { NOT = { any_rite_tenet = { status = core this = scope:lyd_c2_snapshot_item } } } }
every_rite_tenet = { status = permitted scope:lyd_c2_target_school = { change_variable = { name = lyd_c2_check_count add = 1 } } }
if = { limit = { var:lyd_c2_check_count != var:lyd_c2_target_permitted_total } scope:lyd_c2_actor = { set_variable = { name = lyd_c2_snapshot_valid value = 0 } } }
if = { limit = { scope:lyd_c2_target_school = { NOT = { any_rite_tenet = { status = permitted this = scope:lyd_c2_snapshot_item } } } }
every_rite_tenet = { status = known scope:lyd_c2_target_school = { change_variable = { name = lyd_c2_check_count add = 1 } } }
if = { limit = { var:lyd_c2_check_count != var:lyd_c2_target_known_total } scope:lyd_c2_actor = { set_variable = { name = lyd_c2_snapshot_valid value = 0 } } }
if = { limit = { scope:lyd_c2_target_school = { NOT = { any_rite_tenet = { status = known this = scope:lyd_c2_snapshot_item } } } }
every_rite_tenet = { status = prohibited scope:lyd_c2_target_school = { change_variable = { name = lyd_c2_check_count add = 1 } } }
if = { limit = { var:lyd_c2_check_count != var:lyd_c2_target_prohibited_total } scope:lyd_c2_actor = { set_variable = { name = lyd_c2_snapshot_valid value = 0 } } }
if = { limit = { scope:lyd_c2_target_school = { NOT = { any_rite_tenet = { status = prohibited this = scope:lyd_c2_snapshot_item } } } }
if = { limit = { scope:lyd_c2_target_school = { NOT = { rite_has_doctrine = scope:lyd_c2_snapshot_item } } }
var:lyd_c2_target_faith = { every_faith_rite = { scope:lyd_c2_actor = { change_variable = { name = lyd_c2_check_rites add = 1 } } } }
if = { limit = { var:lyd_c2_check_rites != var:lyd_c2_target_rite_total } set_variable = { name = lyd_c2_snapshot_valid value = 0 } }
if = { limit = { is_ai = no is_alive = yes }
if = { limit = { var:lyd_c2_target_total = 0 NOT = { head_of_rite = { is_alive = yes is_adult = yes NOT = { has_trait = incapable } rite = scope:lyd_c2_target_school } } }
# ACTOR must be a live player. All snapshots belong to this round, not a faith ID.
if = { limit = { lyd_c2_start_join_trigger = yes } scope:actor = { lyd_c2_start_round_effect = { KIND = 1 } } }
if = { limit = { lyd_c2_start_detach_trigger = yes } lyd_c2_start_round_effect = { KIND = 2 } }
# The initiator is proposed as the source representative; the selected recipient
# is proposed as receiving representative. Their ballots authorize THESE people,
# rather than treating sponsor or recipient selection as an existing mandate.
scope:lyd_c2_actor = { add_to_variable_list = { name = lyd_c2_target_followers target = scope:lyd_c2_voter } }
option = { name = lyd_c2_cancel trigger = { lyd_c2_initiator_event_context_trigger = yes } lyd_c2_event_cancel_round_effect = yes }
is_shown = { lyd_c2_actor_trigger = yes NOT = { rite = faith.main_rite } }
